subject: Clarify buyer approvals & evidence for AWS Marketplace private offer (term options)
messages:
From: Mary Carter <mary.carter@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 7 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — approvals and term questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement has a couple of follow-ups before we can accept a private offer in the Marketplace:

- We need to confirm what evidence Redwood will provide to support the security and data handling sections for our internal approvers (SOC2 scope, data residency notes, audit logs).
- Our legal team is pushing back on multi-year commitments; they prefer 12 months with an option to renew. Is there a price delta if we choose 12 months vs 24 months?
- Who at Redwood signs the PO and are there any gating approvers required on your side once the PO is submitted via AWS private offer?

Can you outline what you can attach to the private offer and what your standard buyer-approval path looks like? If easier, a short mutual action plan would help speed procurement.

Appreciate it — Mary
Mary Carter
Sr. Procurement Manager, AcmeHealth

---
Attachment: acme-questionnaire.xlsx (stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Mary Carter <mary.carter@acmehealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer — approvals and term questions

Hi Mary — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Evidence we can attach to the private offer / send concurrently:
   - SOC 2 Type II attestation (summary + report under NDA)
   - Data processing addendum and notes about region controls (we can mark AWS region in the offer)
   - Sample audit-log extract and retention policy (PDF)
   - Security questionnaire answers (we'll populate your spreadsheet)

2) Term / pricing options:
   - 12 months: list price applies; standard Marketplace private-offer flow supports 12-month PO.
   - 24 months: we can offer a ~12% discount and extended activation credit; requires approvals from sales finance.
   - We'll include a short price table in the offer attachment so procurement can compare.

3) Signatory & approvals on Redwood side:
   - Finance signs POs up to $250k. Anything larger requires manager approval; very large deals (> $1M) go to legal and CRO.
   - For AWS private offer activation the buyer must accept the offer in AWS console; we then confirm activation and routing.

Proposed next step: I'll attach an evidence pack and two term options (12m / 24m) as a spreadsheet. Vanessa, Marcus — could you confirm the 24m discount band and whether we need a formal internal approval ticket if Acme selects 24 months?

Mary — if that sounds good I can send the populated questionnaire and the two-option PO draft by EOD.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 7 Apr 2028 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer — approvals and term questions

Quick internal note and confirm:

- 24-month discount: Marcus and I confirmed a standard 12% list discount for ARR-based private offers for this segment; for renewals or usage guarantees we can stretch to 15% but require a finance exception ticket.
- Approval path: 24m deals above $300k MRR-equivalent require Ops & Finance explicit signoff; we'll open an internal approval (SALE-1234) once the ACV lands in HubSpot.
- Evidence: SOC2 summary + DPA + short security memo are sufficient for procurement in most health-care buyers; for clinical-data scoped use cases we need a scoped audit under NDA.

Soojin — I suggest sending the 12-month PO draft as the baseline and including a separate line in the offer that calls out the 24-month discount and the internal approval requirements so procurement is aware of the gating.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Soojin / team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Procurement reviewed the evidence pack and the price options you sent. A few quick decisions so we can activate: 

- Acme will proceed with the 12-month term for now (internal policy). Please issue the private offer with the 12-month pricing; we may revisit 24 months at renewal.
- Attach the SOC2 summary and the DPA to the offer (we can pull the full report under NDA if needed later).
- Destination region: US-West-2 must be specified in the offer (our data residency requirement).

Mary and I will accept the offer once the PO is visible in AWS. Please confirm the Redwood signatory and the expected time-to-activate after acceptance.

John Doe
VP, Product, AcmeHealth
